title: Guest browses TORs, searches, filters, pages, opens detail and analytics (no login)

steps.action: Open the dashboard as a guest
steps.expected: Heading "ค้นหาโครงการจากหน่วยงานภาครัฐ" and at least one TOR card are visible

steps.action: Click the second hero slide indicator
steps.expected: The slide indicator state changes (markup of the indicators differs before and after)

steps.action: Type a keyword in the search box
steps.expected: After the 300 ms debounce the list is requested with q= (HTTP 200) and the URL carries q=

steps.action: Go to the next page of results
steps.expected: The URL shows page=2 and the first card is a different project than on page 1

steps.action: Use the filters: software toggle, agency, bidding status, minimum budget, sort
steps.expected: Software, agency, status and budget each change the URL; sorting by highest budget re-orders the list (sorting is applied on the page, not in the URL)
steps.actual: software=0, agency, status, budgetMin, sort re-ordered

steps.action: Click the first TOR card as a guest
steps.expected: Clicking a card as a guest goes to the sign-in page with ?next=/tors/<id>

steps.action: Open a TOR detail page directly as a guest
steps.expected: URL is /tors/<id>; the TOR overview is shown with the notice "เข้าสู่ระบบเพื่อดูรายละเอียดโครงการฉบับเต็ม"; the comparison card with the company profile ("มูลค่าผลงานขั้นต่ำตาม TOR") is not shown to a guest

steps.action: Open the document page of the TOR
steps.expected: The page shows the same project title as the detail page

steps.action: Open Analytics and change a filter
steps.expected: The analytics API is called again with HTTP 200 and the page stays populated

steps.action: Clear the filters
steps.expected: The filter returns to its first option and the data reloads

steps.action: Switch the chart mode to "ความพร้อมเอกสาร" and back
steps.expected: The chart heading changes to "ความพร้อมของเอกสาร TOR" and returns to "TOR ตามปีงบประมาณ"

steps.action: Export the analytics as CSV and as JSON
steps.expected: Two downloads start: a .csv and a .json file

steps.action: Toggle the theme and collapse the sidebar
steps.expected: The theme control changes the page theme and the sidebar toggle flips aria-expanded

steps.action: Open the public pages on a phone-sized screen (360 px) and a tablet (768 px)
steps.expected: No page is wider than the screen (no sideways scrolling) on /, /projects, /analytics and /dashboard

title: Register, log out, log in by email and username, error cases, Google redirect

steps.action: Open the sign-in page
steps.expected: The login form (identifier and password) is shown

steps.action: Switch to "สร้างบัญชี" and submit with mismatching passwords
steps.expected: The alert says the two passwords do not match ("ไม่ตรงกัน")
steps.actual: รหัสผ่านทั้งสองช่องไม่ตรงกัน

steps.action: Submit with a password shorter than 15 characters
steps.expected: The browser blocks the submit (password field reports "too short") and no account is created

steps.action: Register with a valid email, username and password
steps.expected: The account is created and the user lands inside the app; the session belongs to the new email

steps.action: Log out
steps.expected: Returns to the sign-in page and the session is gone (/api/auth/me = 401)

steps.action: Log in with a wrong password
steps.expected: The same generic error is shown for a wrong password on a real account and for an account that does not exist (no account enumeration)
steps.actual: same message for known and unknown account: อีเมล/ชื่อผู้ใช้หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง หรือโปรดใช้ Google หากสมัครด้วย Google

steps.action: Log in with the email
steps.expected: Signed in as the new account

steps.action: Log out, then log in with the username in upper case
steps.expected: Signed in as the same account (username is case-insensitive)

steps.action: Register again with the same email
steps.expected: An alert says the email already has an account ("มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว")
steps.actual: อีเมลนี้มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบด้วยวิธีเดิม

steps.action: Click "เข้าสู่ระบบด้วย Google"
steps.expected: The browser is sent to accounts.google.com (we stop there; no real Google sign-in)

steps.action: Cleanup: sign in and delete the test account (API)
steps.expected: HTTP 200

title: Guests and normal users cannot reach protected pages and APIs; users cannot see each other's drafts

steps.action: Guest opens /profile
steps.expected: Redirected to the sign-in page

steps.action: Guest opens /admin
steps.expected: Redirected to the sign-in page

steps.action: Guest calls the drafts API and the admin API
steps.expected: 401 for both

steps.action: Sign in as a normal user and open /admin
steps.expected: The page says admin permission is required and shows no admin console

steps.action: Normal user calls the admin API
User A creates a draft (API); user B opens its URL in the browser and via the API
steps.expected: B sees none of A's content in the page; the API answers 404 and B's list is empty
steps.actual: UI shows no content; API 404; B has 0 drafts

steps.action: Check the security headers of a normal page response
steps.expected: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and a frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options rule are sent (this run disables CSP in the test browser, so the header is checked here)

steps.action: Cleanup: delete both test accounts
steps.expected: Both deletions return HTTP 200

title: Edit the company profile, validation, persistence, delete company data, delete account

steps.action: Sign in and open the profile page
steps.expected: Heading "ตั้งค่าโปรไฟล์และทักษะบริษัท" is shown with an empty company name

steps.action: Fill company name, capital, highest past-project value and capacity
steps.expected: The fields hold exactly what was typed

steps.action: Fill registration number, signatory and address
steps.expected: The fields hold exactly what was typed

steps.action: Add a past project and fill it in
steps.expected: The counter shows "ผลงานที่ผ่านมา (1/50)" and the four fields keep their values

steps.action: Pick three skills and one certification
steps.expected: The skills counter shows "3 รายการ" and a picked chip looks different from an unpicked one

steps.action: Turn email notifications on and set threshold and frequency
steps.expected: The switch is on and the frequency select holds a non-default option

steps.action: Click "บันทึกข้อมูลโปรไฟล์"
steps.expected: The save request (PATCH) succeeds with HTTP 200

steps.action: Reload the page
steps.expected: Company name, address, skills, certification, notification switch and the past project are all still there (screen and API)

steps.action: Enter a negative capital and save
steps.expected: The form shows a field error, no save request is sent and the stored value is unchanged
steps.actual: Must be a number between 0 and 1000000000000000.

steps.action: Remove the past project
steps.expected: The counter returns to "ผลงานที่ผ่านมา (0/50)"; after saving, the API stores no past project

steps.action: Create a draft (API), then click "ลบข้อมูลบริษัท" and confirm
steps.expected: Company data and drafts are cleared (checked in the API); the account stays

steps.action: Click "ลบบัญชีผู้ใช้" and confirm
steps.expected: The user is sent to the sign-in page and the session is gone

steps.action: Try to sign in with the deleted account
steps.expected: Sign-in is refused with the generic error
steps.actual: อีเมล/ชื่อผู้ใช้หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง หรือโปรดใช้ Google หากสมัครด้วย Google

title: Signed-in user reads a TOR: summary, qualification checklist (own status), prepare-draft link, dashboard

steps.action: Sign in and open a TOR detail page
steps.expected: No guest notice is shown, and the signed-in-only comparison cards (qualification value and checklist) are present

steps.action: Scroll to the qualification checklist card
steps.expected: Items with the status buttons per item are visible

steps.action: Mark the first item "ผ่าน"
steps.expected: The button is pressed (aria-pressed) and the API reports status pass for that item

steps.action: Change the first item to "ไม่ผ่าน", then press it again
steps.expected: The API reports fail; pressing the same button again returns the item to the system value (manual)

steps.action: Page through the checklist ("ถัดไป →")
steps.expected: A different first item is shown on the next page

steps.action: Click "เตรียมร่างข้อเสนอ"
steps.expected: The BidPrep page opens with projectId in the URL

steps.action: Open the document page of the TOR
steps.expected: The document view shows a project heading

steps.action: Open the dashboard
steps.expected: Cards link to /tors/<id> (not to sign-in), unlike the guest view

steps.action: Cleanup: delete the test account
steps.expected: HTTP 200

title: BidPrep: create a draft, edit, sections, checklist gate, export DOCX, delete

steps.action: Sign in, fill a minimal profile (API) and open "เตรียมข้อเสนอ"
steps.expected: Heading "ร่างข้อเสนอของฉัน" and the empty-list message are shown

steps.action: Create a draft with an unknown TOR id
steps.expected: The message "TOR not found" is shown and no draft page opens

steps.action: Create a draft for a real TOR
steps.expected: The draft editor opens for that TOR at version 1

steps.action: Edit the title and the first section, then save
steps.expected: The save returns HTTP 200 and the version shown becomes 2

steps.action: Add a section
steps.expected: The number of sections goes up by one

steps.action: Delete the added section
steps.expected: The number of sections goes back down by one

steps.action: Save, then look at the export button before the checklist passes
steps.expected: With nothing unsaved, the DOCX button is still disabled and the page asks for every item to be "ผ่าน"

steps.action: Open the checklist tab
steps.expected: The summary cards (ผ่าน / ไม่ผ่าน / ตรวจสอบเอง) are shown and the three numbers add up to the 11 items

steps.action: Mark one item "ไม่ผ่าน"
steps.expected: The "ไม่ผ่าน" counter becomes 1

steps.action: Mark every item "ผ่าน" on all pages
steps.expected: The "ผ่าน" counter equals 11 and the other two are 0

steps.action: Download the DOCX (saving first if the page reports unsaved changes)
steps.expected: A .docx download starts and the file is a valid zip (first bytes "PK")

steps.action: Return to the list and open the saved draft
steps.expected: The draft is listed with its title and opens at version 3 or higher, showing the saved title and first section heading

steps.action: Delete the draft
steps.expected: The list shows the empty message and the API has 0 drafts

steps.action: Cleanup: delete the test account
steps.expected: HTTP 200

title: BidPrep: generate an AI draft (queued job, local model), TOR with a small scope

steps.action: Sign in, fill a profile and open "เตรียมข้อเสนอ"
steps.expected: The page loads with the AI warning

steps.action: Enter a TOR id and click "สร้างร่างด้วย AI"
steps.expected: A job is queued (HTTP 202) and the page shows "กำลังรอผล AI" with a job number

steps.action: Wait for the job to finish (up to 5.5 minutes)
steps.expected: When the job completes the page opens the saved draft (or lists it under "ร่างที่บันทึกไว้"); if the job fails, the page must show why

steps.action: Open the AI draft
steps.expected: The editor shows at least 3 sections, source lists and at least one "[to fill in: ...]" placeholder

steps.action: Cleanup: delete the test account and its drafts
steps.expected: HTTP 200

steps.action: Wait for the job to finish (up to 5.5 minutes)
steps.expected: When the job completes the page opens the saved draft (or lists it under "ร่างที่บันทึกไว้"); if the job fails, the page must show why

steps.expected: The editor shows at least 3 sections, source lists and at least one "[to fill in: ...]" placeholder

steps.expected: HTTP 200

title: Admin console: ingestion status, health, review queue (read only, nothing is triggered)

steps.action: Sign in as an admin
steps.expected: Signed in; the session role is admin

steps.action: Open /admin
steps.expected: The console shows the ingestion status and the scraper health section

steps.action: Read the review queue
steps.expected: The queue finishes loading and shows rows or an empty-state message (not the loading text)

steps.action: Filter the queue by reason
steps.expected: The reason filter is applied to the rows on the page: the row count does not grow

steps.action: Search the queue for text that matches nothing
steps.expected: The queue shows no rows (or only the empty-state row)

steps.action: Admin API status call
steps.expected: HTTP 200 with a pipeline status body

steps.expected: HTTP 200
